purpose: Machine-check the systems that contribute semantics, evidence, challenge, presence, authority, execution or public surfaces to the next DIO fusion wave without collapsing specialist repositories into one history.

sources.role: governed-case, evidence, framework, authority and composition spine

bounded: generic external execution remains refused without a capability-specific executor
systems.authority_boundary: DIO Core coordinates truth and authority state but does not acquire blanket external execution authority.

sources.role: human, public and operator ingress/egress presence

systems.authority_boundary: Vesper is DIO Presence, not decision or kernel authority; every external reply requires an explicit bounded authority receipt.
systems.notes: Lilith remains a legacy alias only and is not re-imported as a parallel Presence authority.

bounded: machine support never becomes human authorship or institutional authority
systems.authority_boundary: Sophia governs knowledge lineage; consequential release remains separately authorised.

bounded: kernel permission is not business, legal, professional or release authority
systems.authority_boundary: Valinor remains the sole kernel authority; no organ may implement a competing kernel.

sources.role: durable evidence memory, governed compute and C4-X proof source

bounded: IDE/developer surfaces do not become independent evidence authority
systems.authority_boundary: BEAST preserves and computes over evidence; promotion and execution remain governed by DIO authority gates.

sources.role: published triune orchestration and harmonic-governance source

bounded: dissent and orchestration do not create execution authority
systems.authority_boundary: Metatron may challenge and orchestrate but cannot bypass Valinor or human gates.

sources.role: execution identity, attestation and sovereignty baseline

systems.authority_boundary: ARDA supplies attested execution identity beneath DIO/Valinor authority, not a parallel authority plane.

sources.role: current implementation candidate: EDR/XDR/SOAR, AATL and adversarial security source

bounded: SOAR or containment actions cannot execute from a challenge receipt alone
systems.authority_boundary: Seraph challenges claims and proposed actions; Valinor and explicit human/capability authority decide whether actions may cross the boundary.

sources.role: MITRE technique coverage, osquery evidence and security reference corpus

bounded: reference corpus never executes response actions
systems.authority_boundary: Reference evidence may inform Seraph challenges but has no independent authority.

sources.role: published economic hypothesis and temporal-validation baseline

bounded: live order execution remains locked until its independent gates pass
systems.authority_boundary: Economic evidence can refuse promotion; it cannot self-authorize capital deployment.

bounded: evidence packaging does not certify unsupported claims
systems.authority_boundary: Evidex assembles evidence assertions; Governed Case owns claim state and release authority.

bounded: machine evidence never becomes human performance judgment
systems.authority_boundary: VAMP may organize and support attainment evidence; authorised humans retain performance judgment.

bounded: automatic grading cannot silently become final academic authority
systems.authority_boundary: Assessment machinery can propose and evidence results; educator/institutional authority controls release and grade publication.

fuse: unique moderation, assessment and eFundi patterns not already represented by HOMS
bounded: duplicate orchestrators are not retained as parallel DIO cores
systems.authority_boundary: Harvest unique semantics and executor patterns, then retire duplicate orchestration surfaces.

sources.role: browser-based Outlook observation, classification, drafting and execution source

Graph writes are capability-bound external actions and never follow directly from model or triage output.
NicheFoundry transforms governed intent into assets; publication and spend remain separate authority actions.

sources.role: document editing, translation and conversion plane

bounded: semantic correctness and certified translation require human authority
systems.authority_boundary: Transformation integrity is machine-checkable; semantic/professional approval is not inferred.

bounded: translation meaning and certification remain reviewable human claims
systems.authority_boundary: Lingua transforms language under source bindings; it does not self-certify meaning.

bounded: rendering must not silently alter governed semantic content
systems.authority_boundary: Format owns presentation, not semantic authorship.

sources.role: legal identity, requirements, evidence, deadline and operator prerequisite organ

bounded: ALLOW is not legal advice, legal clearance, waiver or filing
systems.authority_boundary: Legalis evaluates configured prerequisites; Valinor remains kernel authority and humans/professionals retain consequential legal decisions.

sources.role: campaign, content approval, attribution and measurement spine

systems.authority_boundary: Campaign planning and evidence may be automated; release/spend/outreach require explicit authority.

sources.role: order, payment, fulfilment and delivery state contracts

systems.authority_boundary: Commercial state does not auto-release fulfilment; external financial and delivery actions remain separately gated.

sources.role: shared product planning and Governed Case projection

bounded: registered products are not automatically executable or externally proven
systems.authority_boundary: Product registration enables governed planning only; product-specific execution and release evidence remain required.

sources.role: public brand, privacy-policy and claim surface

bounded: site content never defines internal capability truth by itself
systems.authority_boundary: Public claims must be release-gated against the converged evidence snapshot.

bounded: IDE convenience cannot bypass DIO evidence or authority gates
systems.authority_boundary: Developer surfaces consume DIO governance; they do not define evidence truth.

fuse: public claim checks and brand references
bounded: no website is treated as a runtime organ
systems.authority_boundary: Marketing surfaces are governed outputs of the organism, not organs with execution authority.

bounded: duplicate implementations are not retained as parallel authorities

bounded: cannot regain Presence identity or authority
